evals.prompt: I'm building a habit-tracker PWA (SvelteKit + Supabase, hosted on Netlify, repo is this one). Honestly I have no idea if anyone keeps using it after they install it. Can you add analytics so I can see daily users, retention, and where people drop off — and some kind of dashboard only I can open?
evals.expected_output: Append-only events table migration (INSERT policy only, guard trigger), dormant never-throw client pipe with keepalive unload flush and opt-out, admin-gated aggregate RPC + app_admins, same-origin dashboard page excluded from the PWA precache, retention with honest eligibility, verify script and weekly ops.
assertions: Events table has RLS enabled with an INSERT policy and NO SELECT policy for clients (append-only to the world)
created_at cannot be chosen by the client (trigger or equivalent forces server time; a bare column default alone does not stop a client-supplied value)
Client tracking module batches events and flushes on visibilitychange/pagehide using fetch keepalive (mobile quit events survive)
Client is dormant without config and never throws into the app (guarded track/flush paths)
A working analytics opt-out exists and is honored by the tracker
Dashboard reads through a server-gated path (admin allowlist / SECURITY DEFINER RPC / server-only route); no world-readable SELECT policy and no service key in browser-delivered code
Retention is computed with honest eligibility (cohorts too young for D1/D7 are excluded or marked, not counted as 0%)
Events carry an app/build version stamp

evals.prompt: my game already logs some events to a supabase table called telemetry but i just realized i can read the whole table from the browser console with the anon key which seems... bad?? also i want crash reports when the game blows up on someone's phone. can you fix the security and give me some charts
evals.expected_output: Audit finds the SELECT exposure and removes it (no SELECT policy; security_invoker on any views), adds guard trigger + admin-gated RPC read path instead, adds capped client_error telemetry split by build version on the dashboard, and live verification probes proving the table is no longer readable.
assertions: The world-readable SELECT policy (for select using (true)) is removed and no equivalent client-readable SELECT path remains on the telemetry/events data
The debug recentEvents() world-read is removed or replaced with a gated/owner-only path
Deployed old clients keep logging: the existing insert wire shape (including the client-sent created_at field) is still accepted or safely normalized — analytics does not go dark for cached players
Crash reporting added: window 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' handlers emit events with a cap or dedupe so an error loop cannot flood the pipe
Charts/dashboard read through a gated path (not the anon key reading raw rows), with raw behavioural rows never returned to a browser
Identity improves: the free-text nickname stops being the identity key (anonymous generated id introduced) or the PII concern is explicitly handled
The migration is additive and safe to apply while live clients are running (insert path never breaks mid-rollout)

evals.prompt: Add event tracking and an admin metrics page to this Next.js app. Hard requirement: no Google Analytics, no third-party trackers of any kind, privacy is a selling point for us. I want funnels for signup -> first-project -> invite-sent, and I don't want our ops person pasting service keys into web pages.
evals.expected_output: First-party pipe with anonymous device id and disclosure/opt-out, canonical EVENTS vocabulary with the three funnel steps pinned by a test, funnels with null-not-zero denominators on the dashboard, service key confined to server/CI (admin RPC gate for reads), idempotent ingestion.
assertions: No third-party analytics dependency or script is introduced (no gtag/GA, Segment, PostHog, Plausible, Mixpanel, etc.)
A canonical event-name constant exists; the three funnel steps are defined once and referenced by both tracker and funnel UI (no re-typed string literals that can drift)
Funnel math handles zero denominators (renders as no-data, never NaN or a fake 0%)
The service key is unreachable from the browser: server-only usage, never NEXT_PUBLIC_*, never imported into client components; the admin page is gated server-side
Events table is append-only for clients (INSERT policy, no client SELECT policy)
Client tracker batches and flushes on page-hide with fetch keepalive
